title: Memory-bank and Wavelet-based Network for Long Ultrasound Video Segmentation
core_idea: Propose a segmentation network that combines wavelet-based convolutions with a long-short-term memory bank to fuse spatiotemporal features, model long-term dependencies, and emphasize high-frequency fine-grained details and small objects in long ultrasound videos.
tldr: Introduce a memory-bank-and-wavelet architecture to fuse multi-scale spatiotemporal features and highlight high-frequency details for improved segmentation in long ultrasound video.
